Conventional platforms such as Stripe and PayPal are often unavailable, limiting the ability to monetize work effectively. This is where sovereign commerce infrastructure comes into play, empowering creators by providing robust tools for automating sales and payments directly from their own online stores. By leveraging [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-explained-digital-creators-12|crypto]]currencies for transactions, creators gain [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-23|COREMERCH guide to financial]] independence without the constraints of traditional payment methods. This guide breaks down the infrastructure necessary for selling design assets without relying on Stripe or similar services.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Design assets

At its core, this infrastructure is about ownership and autonomy in digital commerce. Instead of relying on third-party platforms, creators can set up their own systems for selling digital assets. This means they control their product listings, payment processing, and customer data. Using a combination of tools like Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments, creators can automate the entire sales process without needing to pay hefty fees to intermediaries. This matters because it allows for greater profit margins, reduced transaction costs, and a direct relationship with customers. In regions where financial systems are unreliable or inaccessible, having a sovereign platform ensures creators can operate freely and effectively.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture consists of several key components that work together seamlessly. First, hosting is handled through platforms like Cloudflare Pages, providing fast and reliable access to your digital storefront. For backend logic, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers execute the necessary functions to manage orders and handle customer interactions. Data storage is facilitated by Supabase or Google Sheets, creating an organized repository for tracking sales and managing product delivery. Finally, NOWPayments integrates cryptocurrency payment processing directly into the system, allowing creators to accept payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies with minimal fees. This architecture creates a cohesive system that functions independently of traditional payment processors, ensuring stability and control.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are limited or non-existent. If you're a designer in Kenya selling assets like courses, templates, or graphics and have struggled with payment processing, this solution is tailored for you. It empowers creators to take charge of their commercial endeavors without being impeded by outdated systems. The ability to accept cryptocurrency payments not only circumvents local banking constraints but also opens up a global market for your products. It's about building a resilient commercial ecosystem that prioritizes your needs as a digital creator.
Take control of your sales with a sovereign commerce solution.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component of this infrastructure is essential for creating a smooth and efficient sales process. Cloudflare Pages provides the web hosting where your online store lives, ensuring quick access for users. Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers handle backend operations, including order processing and inventory management. Data is stored securely on Supabase or Google Sheets, allowing for easy access and manipulation. NOWPayments enables you to accept payments in cryptocurrencies, offering immediate transaction confirmation and minimal fees. Together, these components create a robust system that allows you to automate sales without relying on external platforms, thus maintaining complete control over your business.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with this sovereign commerce infrastructure, follow these steps: First, choose your hosting option, either Cloudflare Pages for static sites or Cloudflare Workers for dynamic content. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script for simplicity. For data management, select between Supabase or Google Sheets based on your preference for relational databases or spreadsheets. After that, integrate NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Each of these tools is designed for easy integration and can be set up within hours. For a comprehensive resource, consider the Complete Builder Kit, which provides all necessary templates and blueprints to deploy your system effectively. With these components in place, you can launch your digital storefront confidently.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling design assets using crypto payments is achievable through a sovereign commerce infrastructure, which does not rely on platforms like Stripe. Instead, creators can utilize tools such as Cloudflare Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments to establish an independent online store. This system allows for automated product delivery and secure payment processing, preserving full ownership and control over the sales process.
Accept payments in cryptocurrencies without traditional barriers.

The Complete Builder Kit is the all-in-one solution for creators looking to deploy their sales infrastructure quickly and efficiently. This kit includes blueprints and templates that simplify the setup process, enabling you to start selling your design assets without traditional payment barriers. With it, you can establish a fully operational online store that accepts cryptocurrency payments seamlessly.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting solution: Cloudflare Pages for static sites or Cloudflare Workers for dynamic applications. 2. Set up Google Apps Script for backend logic to process orders and manage functionalities. 3. Use Supabase or Google Sheets to store order data securely. 4. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. 5. Load your products into the system for sale. 6. Test the entire setup to ensure functionality from product selection to payment confirmation. 7. Launch your online store and start promoting your design assets to potential customers.
Frequently Asked Questions
What types of digital assets can I sell?
You can sell a variety of digital assets, including ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software.
How do customers receive their purchases?
Customers receive their purchases automatically through the system, with files delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 upon successful payment.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
You can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies using NOWPayments, offering flexibility in payment options for your customers.
Is there a fee for using this infrastructure?
The only fee incurred is a 0.5% transaction fee through NOWPayments, making it cost-effective for creators.
Can I customize my online store?
Yes, the infrastructure allows for extensive customization, enabling you to tailor your online store to fit your branding and product offerings.
